mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appointment_id, a.status AS appointment_status, p.id AS patient_id, p.real_name AS patient_real_name, s.id AS schedule_id, s.work_date AS schedule_work_date, s.time_slot AS schedule_time_slot, s.capacity AS schedule_capacity, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, dept.id AS department_id, dept.name AS department_name, c.id AS campus_id, c.name AS campus_name, c.address AS campus_address, director.id AS director_id, director.name AS director_name, director.title AS director_title, mr.id AS medical_record_id, mr.diagnosis AS medical_record_diagnosis, mr.prescription AS medical_record_prescription FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON dept.id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN campus c ON c.id = dept.campus_id LEFT JOIN doctor director ON director.id = dept.director_id LEFT JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.appointment_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId}
